about: ART-5 5b landmark (bible 4.4). Built by tools/art_pipeline/city/build_landmarks_v1.py; do not edit by hand.
concept_source: art-concepts-r43 (art-pass 097a6c0 round 31 builders; d14b8f6 round 34 crest)

coordinates.frame: glTF x = lot x, glTF z = lot y (CityIsoCamera.lot_to_world), origin = centre of the job's lot rectangle at ground level
coordinates.front: as the concept built them: HQs are symmetric or face the iso camera's side (+x, +z); Meridian's gate faces +x and its rail yard runs along x at z = -34 / -40 (the round 31 combat camera looks from -z); a Site's front faces +z (lot +y: screen lower-left, as in the locked Site renders)

materials.note: COLOR_0 is linear: rgb = base colour x the per-triangle tone jitter (0.86-1.12) for toon roles; alpha = a part id (toon roles: write it to ROUGHNESS 0.5-1.0 for material-edge ink) or a window's own seeded value (window roles)
materials.lm_toon: 3-band toon (spike city_building light(): ramp shadow / mid / lit on N.L, edges 0.118 / 0.363)
materials.lm_toon_lines: lm_toon, darkened toward (8, 6, 12)/255 by 0.55 x reveal q (REBEL_CELL detail-line buildings)
materials.lm_neon: emissive colour x neon gain (night 1.0, day 0.75)
materials.lm_window: emissive colour x window gain (night 1.0; day 0.55 mixed 0.55 toward dark glass (0.10, 0.14, 0.20))
materials.lm_window_ring: lm_window, visible while alpha > reveal q (+/- 0.12 flicker band at the front): the blackout ring
materials.lm_window_lines: lm_window, visible while alpha < (1 - q) x 0.85: lit detail lines before the reveal
materials.lm_window_fist_home: red fist windows, home look (70 % density baked)
materials.lm_window_fist_dispatch: red fist windows, DISPATCH look (90 %, glitch rows, a few white); show instead of _home
materials.lm_beam: additive translucent light cone, emission colour x 0.22
materials.lm_sign: flat emissive sign colour (corp sign colour)

animation.note: rest pose = the concept's still; play the animation looped
